name: a2b-marketplace
description: Personal plugin marketplace for A2B / Mayz. Holds spec-crystallizer, legacy-code-explorer, and any future skills and plugins.

plugins.name: spec-crystallizer
plugins.description: Non-leading spec interviewer plus a zero-context cold-read critic. Externalize what's in your head, catch the gaps a fresh reader hits, stop at MVP-ready.

plugins.name: legacy-code-explorer
plugins.description: Explores legacy code before you refactor it: answers questions about flow, UI, and logic coupling, grades refactor risk per area, and writes a markdown knowledge document.
